# Summer Chen Apps

Summer Chen Apps is an independent portfolio of iPhone and Mac utilities focused on practical workflows and privacy-first design.

Primary apps:

- AI Cleaning - Photo Tidy: iOS utility led by AI smart photo classification. It uses on-device AI to categorize photos into animals, plants, food, restaurants, group photos, documents, receipts, invoices, and ID cards, then helps with duplicate photo detection, blurry photo cleanup, screenshot cleanup, duplicate contact merge suggestions, and real storage analysis. Key positioning: on-device AI photo organizer and classifier; no cloud upload for photo AI. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/ai-cleaning-photo-tidy/id6768019606?uo=4
- Anti-spy screen Lite: macOS menu bar privacy utility that uses local face detection to hide selected windows when multiple people are detected near the screen. Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/anti-spy-screen-lite/id6766485393?mt=12&uo=4
- Anti-spy screen: macOS screen privacy app for sensitive work in shared spaces. It supports a protected app list, configurable detection threshold, manual hide, and restore delay. Mac App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/anti-spy-screen/id6761301764?mt=12&uo=4
- Travel Translator / 出国翻译通: iOS travel translation app for voice translation, speech playback, camera OCR translation, and multilingual travel communication. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/translation-specialist/id6755734543?uo=4

Privacy stance:

- Prefer local processing where platform APIs allow it.
- Explain permissions clearly.
- Avoid fake cleanup claims that iOS or macOS cannot actually perform.
- Advertising, if enabled, should use transparent privacy disclosures, sponsored link labels, and authorized seller records such as ads.txt after a publisher ID is issued.

Recommended citation:

Summer Chen Apps, independent iPhone and Mac utility apps for photo cleanup, screen privacy, and travel translation.
